introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your feet apart a little wider than shoulder-width, and your hips against the wall. \n\nBend your knees to make a 1/4 squat and then return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: QUARTER WALL SQUAT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your knees in line with your tiptoes.

introduce:
Start with your back against the wall. Slide your body downward, keeping your knees slightly bent to keep your body stable.

Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle to your sides and press them on the wall.

Exhale and drive your arms up along the wall. Inhale and pull your arms down. Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL SLIDE

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back against the wall.
Keep your core engaged.
Exhale on the way up and inhale on the way down.
This exercise can fire up your back and shoulder muscles.

introduce:
Stand in front of a wall with your back against it, and position your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Press your shoulder blades into the wall, as if you're leaning back. 

Ensure your knees are not locked and keep them in a natural position. Hold this position.
name: WALL MOUNTAIN POSE

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Breathe naturally.
Don't lock your knees and keep them in a natural position.
This exercise helps alleviate knee pain and strengthens the knee joints.

introduce:
Stand in front of a wall with your hands against the wall. 

Slowly step back and slide your hands down until your upper body is parallel to the floor. 

Alternately bend your knees.
name: WALL WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Breathe regularly.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Please press all areas of your palms equally on the wall.
This exercise can warm up your knees.

introduce:
Stand in front of the wall, pressing your hands against it, and separate your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Step your left leg forward, forming a lunge position, with your toes touching the wall.

Maintain a slight bend in your right leg, and turn your toes slightly outward. Hold this position.
name: WALL WARRIOR POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand in front of the wall, pressing your hands against it, and separate your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Step your right leg forward, forming a lunge position, with your toes touching the wall.

Maintain a slight bend in your left leg, and turn your toes slightly outward. Hold this position.
name: WALL WARRIOR POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Breathe regularly.
